admission_info.application_deadline: The regular admission deadline is March 15th each year. Early decision deadline is November 1st.
admission_info.required_documents: We require official transcripts, SAT/ACT scores, two letters of recommendation, and a personal essay.
admission_info.application_fee: The application fee is $50 USD. Fee waivers are available for qualified low-income applicants.
admission_info.program_duration: Undergraduate programs typically take 4 years to complete. Some specialized programs may take 5 years.
admission_info.tuition_fees: Annual tuition is $45,000 for in-state students and $55,000 for out-of-state students.
admission_info.financial_aid: We offer need-based aid, merit scholarships, federal loans, and work-study opportunities.
admission_info.campus_life: Our campus features modern facilities, student clubs, sports programs, and residential housing.
admission_info.course_offerings: We offer over 100 undergraduate majors and minors across engineering, liberal arts, business, and sciences.
admission_info.admission_status: Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Decisions are typically sent within 4-6 weeks of receiving a complete application.
admission_info.transfer_students: Transfer students must have a minimum GPA of 2.5 and can transfer up to 60 credit hours.
admission_info.ielts_requirement: The minimum IELTS score required is 6.5 overall, with no band less than 6.0. TOEFL iBT minimum is 80.
admission_info.international_students: Yes, international students are welcome to apply. Requirements include: valid passport, student visa, English proficiency test (IELTS/TOEFL) with minimum IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 80, academic transcripts evaluation by WES or equivalent, and proof of financial support showing funds for tuition and living expenses.
admission_info.eligibility: To be eligible for admission, applicants must have a minimum high school GPA of 3.0 (on a 4.0 scale) and minimum SAT score of 1000 or ACT score of 21. International students must also meet English proficiency requirements (IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 80).

contact_info.office_hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM EST

faqs.when_apply: You can apply anytime from September to March for fall admission or January to August for spring admission.
faqs.how_long_decision: Most decisions take 4-6 weeks for regular review. Early decision applications are processed within 2-3 weeks.
faqs.appeal_decision: You can appeal an admission decision by submitting additional information or achievements.
faqs.deferment: If deferred, you can submit updates showing how your academic performance or achievements have improved.
faqs.housing: On-campus housing is guaranteed for first-year students. Housing selection for other years is based on seniority.
